summary: Iteration 2: tested Kitchen Dashboard (owner), no-auto-timer, owner cancel/reject, order ratings, favourites, sizeless items, plus customer regression (login, menu, cart, WELCOME10 promo, checkout, tracking, orders tab, re-order). Backend: 37/37 pytest pass (one obsolete auto-timer test in test_fornello_api.py was updated to assert orders stay 'placed'). Frontend: owner login -> /kitchen, stat cards, filter chips, all 5 advance buttons (Accept order/Start baking/Quality check/Send out for delivery/Mark delivered), Reject panel with 4 reason chips + Keep order/Reject order, Completed view with 'Rejected: <reason>', Ratings view (average 4.5, ranked items, recent reviews), sign out all work. Customer: 'Waiting for the kitchen' after checkout, tracking updated live via polling when owner advanced (confirmed->baking->...->delivered), red Cancelled banner with reason appears live, star rating form -> read-only rating, Orders tab shows cancelled reason / rated stars / Rate this order / Re-order, favourites heart per size on item page, builder heart, Home 'Your favourites' one-tap add (cart badge 1->2), Profile favourites add-to-cart + remove. One bug found and FIXED: /kitchen redirected to /login on page reload/deep link because kitchen.tsx did not wait for auth 'ready' (owner refresh logged them out of the dashboard view; customer was sent to /login instead of /). No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: Rate-limit key is the FIRST X-Forwarded-For entry, which is client-controlled: an attacker can rotate a fake XFF header to bypass brute-force protection. Prefer the right-most proxy-appended IP (or the ingress's real-IP header). Also successful logins count toward the 40/15min budget, which made automated tests hit 429.

Order number = countDocuments()+1001 is not atomic and the schema has no unique index on 'number'; two simultaneous checkouts can get the same order number (kitchen staff identify orders by #number). Use an atomic counter (findOneAndUpdate $inc) + unique index.

name/unitPrice/image/details are stored exactly as the client sent them (key not checked against menu, price not re-computed). Order pricing is server-side so no money risk, but a favourite can show a stale/wrong price after a menu price change; consider re-pricing favourites server-side from key/details.

'today' uses server local midnight (container TZ, likely UTC), not the shop's timezone; 'Delivered today'/'Revenue today' can roll over at the wrong hour. Also the per-item ranking includes drinks/sides although the UI title says 'Pizzas ranked by rating'.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: reload / deep link on /kitchen redirected owner to /login (and customer to /login instead of /) because user is null until stored session loads. Added `if (!ready) return <Loading/>` before redirects. Verified: owner reload stays on /kitchen; customer /kitchen -> /.
Average 4.5 renders 5 full stars (Math.round) — looks like a perfect score. Recent reviews show only filled stars (e.g. ★★★★ with no empty star), inconsistent with the header and the customer view.

issues: 4 stat cards are in a horizontal scroller: 'Delivered today' card is clipped and 'Revenue today' is fully off-screen with no scroll affordance — consider a 2x2 grid so the owner sees revenue at a glance
Filter chips row clips the 'Ratings' chip at the right edge
Remove (X) deletes a favourite instantly with no undo/confirm, unlike addresses which have a confirm step

action_items: Review the kitchen.tsx auth-ready fix applied by the testing agent (line ~91) and keep it
Rate limiter: do not trust client-supplied first X-Forwarded-For entry; consider skipSuccessfulRequests for login
Make order numbers atomic + unique (counter collection) to avoid duplicate #numbers in the kitchen
Kitchen ratings: show half/rounded-down stars for averages and render empty stars in recent reviews; rename 'Pizzas ranked' or filter to pizzas
Kitchen stat cards: use a 2x2 grid on phones so Revenue is visible without horizontal scrolling
Optional: compute 'today' in the shop timezone; re-price favourites server-side
critical_code_review_comments: requireOwner re-reads role from DB on every request (good); register ignores a client 'role' field (verified)
advance/cancel use conditional findOneAndUpdate on current status — race-safe (good)
Owner can still open customer stack routes directly (/cart, /checkout, /item/:id) — only the tabs layout redirects owners; low risk
Rating endpoint returns 404 (not 403) for another customer's order — acceptable, avoids leaking existence

success_rate.frontend: ~96% (1 bug found and fixed, minor visual issues)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ customer accounts (test_*@example.com) and TEST_ orders (notes 'TEST_order'/'TEST_ui_checkout'); orders cannot be deleted via API so they were moved to cancelled (reason 'TEST_cleanup'/'TEST_Closing soon') or delivered. testy's order #1014 was advanced to delivered and rated 4 stars ('TEST_ crispy crust'); #1027 placed via UI and cancelled. TEST_Kitchen's delivered order #1016 has a 4-star 'TEST_tasty' review that now appears in the owner's Ratings/Recent reviews and affects the average. NOTE: during the Profile favourites UI test the testing agent removed testy's pre-existing 'Margherita Fiore (Classic 11")' favourite; it was re-created via API with identical content (new id).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env var for tests is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run pytest with -n0. Auth limiter = 40 login/register per 15 min per IP — running both test files + UI tests repeatedly will hit 429; wait for reset. Kitchen order ids for UI tests can be fetched via GET /api/kitchen/orders?filter=new with owner token. Use page.request with owner token to advance orders while the customer tracking screen is open (polling 4s).
rca_of_issue: Kitchen redirect bug: app/kitchen.tsx evaluated `if (!user) <Redirect href='/login'/>` on first render; on web reload/deep link AuthProvider has ready=false and user=null while it reads the stored token, so the screen redirected before the session loaded. Repro: log in as owner, reload /kitchen -> /login. Fix: read `ready` from useAuth and render <Loading/> until ready.
